note: Questions as an executive types them, each with 1-2 messy rephrasings (`messy`, asked as paraphrases) (short, messy, no use-case name). Each card names a family of evals/live_ops_keys.py, which picks the records it asks about and computes the key from the system of record on every run (scripts/eval_live_ops.py keys). A card asks about `instances` records; {slot} is the record's identifier. `facts` keeps only those facts of the family (default: all). Never an expected value here: keys are computed, stored outside the repository, and split dev / held out by evals.partition groups. Cards with "suite": "ceo" are the CEO suite (evals/live_ops_ceo.py and harder phrasings of core families): split on their own after the core (scripts/eval_live_ops.split), run alone with --suite ceo.
